newsitem.title: FRANCE: Fr Telecom has 25 bln franc share capital.
newsitem.headline: Fr Telecom has 25 bln franc share capital.

text.p: France Telecom will from January 1 be a state-owned company with a share capital of 25 billion francs, in one billion shares of 25 franc nominal each, according to the Journal Officiel published on Monday.
The official journal, dated Sunday, said that state would hold all of the shares.
The decree said the share capital could be changed but that no change could have the effect of the state losing its majority.
It added that when the shares would be listed, anybody owning a stake of 0.5 percent would have to inform the company.

The decree said that France Telecom would levy at least five percent of its profits towards a legal reserve until the moment that this reserve makes up a 10th of its share capital, or 2.5 billion francs.
